# miniz 3.1.2 (vendored)

ZIP reading and writing for `.ppk2` captures. Unmodified amalgamated release `miniz-3.1.2.zip` from
https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/releases (sha256 of the archive
`f0446d863f9c19926ad9483c523fdc42e42b8d4a6a431d27e09d49c79a140d9a`).

Licence: MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Built as a private object library inside the modules that use
it (no zlib-compatible names, so it never clashes with a zlib in the same program).
